title: Synonym
description: Learn how to create synonyms as aliases for database objects in SQL Server.

data.text: A synonym is an alias or alternative name for a database object such as a table, view, stored procedure, user-defined function, or sequence. Synonyms provide a layer of abstraction and simplify object references.

data.title: CREATE SYNONYM Syntax
data.content: Creates a synonym for a database object.

data.text: The object for which you create the synonym does not have to exist at the time the synonym is created.

data.title: Create Synonym for a Table
data.content: Creates a synonym for the sales.orders table.
data.code:
CREATE SYNONYM orders FOR sales.orders;

SELECT * FROM orders;

data.text: Synonym for a Table in Another Database

data.title: Cross-Database Synonym
data.content: Creates a synonym for a table in another database.

data.title: Drop Synonym
data.content: Drops the orders synonym if it exists.

data.title: Synonym Key Points
points: Use CREATE SYNONYM to create an alias for a database object.
Synonyms simplify references to objects in other databases or schemas.
Synonyms provide abstraction, making it easier to rename underlying objects.
Use DROP SYNONYM to remove a synonym.
The target object does not need to exist when creating the synonym.
